title: Double Decker Tacos
description: Like the ones you get at that famous taco place, only homemade. A soft flour tortilla, spread with refried beans, is wrapped around a crisp taco shell with seasoned meat, cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, and guacamole.
ingredients: 1 (1 ounce) packet taco seasoning mix, divided
salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, and sprinkle about 3/4 of the packet of taco seasoning over the meat. Cook and stir ground beef, breaking it up as it cooks, until beef is browned and crumbly, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain excess grease.

Mash refried beans in a small saucepan; add a little water as needed to loosen (you may not need to add any, depending on the consistency of the beans) and sprinkle with the remaining seasoning. Heat the refried beans over low heat until warmed through and smooth.
Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Place the crisp taco shells on a baking sheet, and warm them in the preheated oven for 3 to 5 minutes.
To make the guacamole: Peel, seed, and mash the avocados in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of sour cream, the lime juice, and salt and pepper to taste, and set aside.

To build the tacos: Spread each flour tortilla with about 2 tablespoons of heated refried beans. Wrap the tortilla gently around a crisp tortilla shell. Spread about 2 tablespoons of ground beef along the bottom of the crisp shell, and sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of shredded Cheddar cheese on top of the meat. Top the cheese with shredded lettuce, a sprinkle of chopped tomato and onion, and a dollop of sour cream and guacamole.

video.description: Expand your taco constructing skills and double your taco delight with this easy and super-satisfying recipe. Cook ground beef and refried beans separately, each with taco seasoning. While you warm crisp taco shells in the oven, make a guacamole of avocado, sour cream, lime juice and salt and pepper. Spread flour tortillas with warm refried beans, then wrap around a crisp shell. Inside the hard shell, layer in the ground beef with Cheddar cheese, shredded lettuce, tomato, onion, sour cream and guac.
